title: Absolutely DISGUSTING behavior
body:
This app set me up with the promise of a 7-day Free Trial, but after a sudden pop-up ad, suddenly changed to “Special offer, charge now & no free trial” What a scam! Unbeknownst to this change, I paid for the yearly subscription and then afterwards realized my blunder. I highly do NOT recommend this blasphemous and outright outrageous app. Stay cautious, mindful and check a few times first before you make your purchase. This rancid, disturbing, discombobulated, distasteful, disadvantageous, disastrous, dishonest, disappointing, atrocious, anger-inducing, ridiculous behavior to scam others for their own benefit is unethical. If there was a 0 Star rating, I would gladly let that be my ranking.
Thank you for reading my review and stay cautious and aware.
